task: Repair / Validator / Queue Hardening — make v2/v3 pipeline reliable

stories.name: Phase 1: Repair apply v2 guard and multi-paper dependency matching
acceptanceCriteria: check_apply_guards defaults expected_artifact_version to 'v2' instead of 'v1'
infer_expected_review_draft_version(review_draft) returns artifact_version or 'v2'
check_apply_guards, apply_patch, RepairApplier.apply_all and run_repair_apply dry-run all use inferred expected version path
_check_dependency_bundle matches against metadata.paper_ids (plural) in addition to legacy metadata.paper_id
Multi-paper proposal with metadata.paper_ids=[A,B] passes guard only when all paper artifacts/dependencies match
Multi-paper proposal fails guard if any required paper artifact is missing or stale
Existing repair tests continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 2: Repair planner v3 field alignment
acceptanceCriteria: Paper identity lookup prefers citation_result.paper_ids → details.paper_ids → details.bundle.paper_ids → legacy paper_id
Block target lookup prefers target_claim_unit.block_id → block_ids[0] → details.target_claim_unit.block_id → legacy details.block_id
Proposal metadata includes paper_ids, citation_set_key, validation_bundle_id, claim_unit_id fields
_build_dependency_bundle is called per paper_id when multiple paper IDs are present
Multi-paper proposals build a composite dependency bundle that fails if any required paper is missing/stale
_find_block_for_citation uses the new priority order for block_id resolution
Existing repair pipeline tests continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 3: Validator/manifest claim-level granularity
acceptanceCriteria: Same paper set in two different block/sentence locations yields same citation_set_key but different validation_bundle_id
claim_unit_results include block_id, sentence_index, span_start, span_end per claim unit
Each claim unit in the report carries stable claim_unit_id, validation_bundle_id, and paper set reference
Validation report metadata includes per-claim-unit block/sentence location information
Aggregate citation result remains backward-compatible with legacy paper_id/block_id fields
Legacy tests for review_validator continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 4: Queue dependency propagation
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency check order: missing→failed, failed→failed, cancelled→cancelled, pending/running→returns early
Failed dependency marks current job FAILED with error_message containing dependency job ID
Cancelled dependency marks current job CANCELLED with status/result summary and no error_message set
Missing dependency marks current job FAILED with error
Pending/running dependency keeps downstream job PENDING (no state change)
Queue drain re-evaluates dependents after parent state changes so propagation happens in one cycle
Existing queue service tests continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 5: Stage 3 continuation, citation retry, checkpoint preservation
acceptanceCriteria: _call_ai_api_text_detailed returns dict with content, finish_reason, raw/metadata while _call_ai_api legacy behavior is unchanged
_call_section_api_optimized uses real finish_reason from _call_ai_api_text_detailed instead of hardcoded 'stop'
Mock finish_reason=length triggers continuation and concatenated content is returned on final stop
One narrow citation-token insertion retry is invoked when section lacks [[cite:...]] tokens
If citation retry succeeds, the section is accepted; if retry fails, the section is recorded as failed and checkpoint preserved
Checkpoint deletion only runs when failed_sections is empty (not before)
On failed sections, review checkpoint file remains and last_completed_section stays at the last successful one
Existing stage tests continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 6: Summary recheck anchor conflicts
acceptanceCriteria: _check_field_source_grounded no longer uses first-50-character substring matching
Anchor extraction identifies years (YYYY), percentages, sample sizes, experiment counts, uppercase acronyms, direction words from summary and source
Paraphrase with no anchor conflict produces no correction candidate (previously false-positive on substring mismatch)
Year conflict between summary and source produces correction candidate
Percentage/sample-size/experiment-count conflict produces correction candidate
Direction-word conflict (increase vs decrease, high vs low) produces candidate
Uppercase acronym present in summary but absent in source produces candidate
Existing summary recheck tests continue to pass

stories.name: Phase 7: Stage 1 strict/partial-success semantics
acceptanceCriteria: Default config adds allow_partial_success=false and min_success_ratio=1.0
process_all_papers returns False when final failed_papers is non-empty and allow_partial_success is false
process_all_papers returns True when final failed_papers is non-empty AND allow_partial_success=true AND success_ratio >= min_success_ratio
process_all_papers returns False when allow_partial_success=true but success_ratio < min_success_ratio
process_all_papers returns True when no failures exist (all papers processed successfully)
Result summary metadata includes: partial_success, failed_count, success_ratio, allow_partial_success
Existing stage 1 tests continue to pass
